welcome.text: Welcome to the Word Finder game! Let's explore together and find some hidden words.

prompt_train.text: Find the colorful toy train on the floor.

prompt_cow.text: Where is the black and white spotted cow?

prompt_frog.text: Can you spot the little green frog sitting on the rock?

prompt_tractor.text: Find the green tractor on the farm.

prompt_dog.text: Where is the happy brown puppy dog?

prompt_ball.text: Can you find the soccer ball on the grass?

prompt_kite.text: Find the bright kite flying high in the sky.

wrong_generic_1.text: Not quite, try looking somewhere else!

wrong_generic_2.text: Give it another try! You can do it.

next_scene.text: Wonderful! Let's travel to our next place!

win.text: Congratulations! You found all the words and completed the adventure!
